about_the_game:
Dive into the chilling world of Aftermath Z: Red Pine Lake, a third and first-person survival horror game that blends heart-pounding single-player storytelling with dynamic multiplayer chaos, all wrapped in a nostalgic 80s slasher aesthetic. Crafted by our small yet passionate team, this project marks the genesis of an exciting new horror franchise. Set in the eerie aftermath of a mysterious virus that transforms victims into grotesque infected husks, players navigate the haunting Red Pine Lake, where every shadow hides a threat. With innovative gameplay, immersive lore, and a unique asymmetrical Infected Mode, our game redefines survival horror, delivering an unforgettable experience that keeps every player engaged—whether they’re hiding, hunting, or fighting for survival.

Game Features

  • Single-Player Campaign: Unravel a gripping narrative as you investigate bizarre deaths in Red Pine Lake. Explore multiple chapters and diverse characters in a tense survival horror experience, scavenging for weapons and piecing together the chilling mystery of the virus.

    Multiplayer Modes:

  • Horde Mode: Team up online to battle waves of zombies across atmospheric, 80s-inspired maps. Earn credits to unlock weapons or discover hidden gear in the environment, fostering replayability and cooperative thrills.

  • Infected Mode: Our flagship asymmetrical mode pits one player as an unstoppable infected slasher—a terrifying tank stalking survivors. Once infected, players transform into zombie minions, turning on their former teammates in an exhilarating game of cat-and-mouse. Survivors must hide, fight, or flee until rescue arrives, ensuring no one is left bored in this ultimate hide-and-seek showdown.

content_descriptors.notes: The players can be killed in a number of violent ways, the zombies are killed which will create blood and potentially the loss of limbs. Some of the characters will be partially nude and there may be scenes of a sexual nature. Some corpses will be found in gory ways and some outfits are revealing.
